text: SUPERVISOR — add to your items-source queue: VOXELSCALE-0606. User verbatim: "the voxels, im pretty sure they are defaulted as 1m x 1m x 1m which if that is true, is going to be a problem, i need it to scale way down for the sake of item size, or have an approach that lets me set the scale of the voxel. because i then have an impossible task of carving for anything that isnt massive scale". First print the data: what IS the current voxel cell size in the VOXEL lens (user says probably 1m cube — confirm from the store/stage, post the number). Then: voxel cell size becomes a SETTABLE per-blockout parameter in the VOXEL lens panel (numbers are tuning data — never hardcoded), with the DEFAULT scaled for item-sized work, not building-sized (pick a sane item default and say what you picked; the user dials from there). The whole pipeline must respect the cell size: stage rendering, face math, W/D/H dims, and critically the voxel->item Globe bake import — an item built from 10cm cells must bake at 10cm cells. Test: author a blockout at a small cell size -> import to item -> resulting item dimensions match cell*count. The user carving an item-sized thing without fighting meter cubes is the PASS.
